_readme: What a posted video actually did. The idea stage has no other memory:
hooks come from banks of other people's wins and the learned rules come
from this file, so a video whose numbers were never written down taught
name      matches edit-scripts/<name>.json where the video went through
the pipeline. That join is the point -- it is what lets a
beat structure be compared against how long people watched.
watch     average seconds watched. `perf.py` turns this into retention,
which is the number that matters; views are downstream of it.
dms       null means not known, which is different from 0.
note      judgement. What you think died, and why. The numbers are the
evidence; this is the reading of them.

posts.name: videoautomationsystem
posts.note: Best so far. Hook is a claim with a named victim -- every short-form editor out of business. HOOK -> TESTKANIN -> THE TAKE -> WHY -> LANDING, five beats. Reach and interest succeeded; nothing proves it produced a client.

posts.name: referenser
posts.note: Died in the first four seconds. Announcement hook -- 'I just got another referral' -- then a truism its audience already believed, with nothing on screen. Not put through the pipeline, so there is no edit script to compare against.
